name: Comment Beautifier
author: garurprani

sections.description:
Comment Beautifier is a powerful WordPress plugin that helps website owners and moderators transform spammy, low-quality comments into genuine, engaging conversations. Instead of simply deleting suspicious comments, you can now convert them into valuable content that enhances your website’s discussion quality.

Key Features

  • Intelligent Spam Defense: Advanced detection algorithms identify and neutralize spam comments
  • Smart Content Transformation: Automatically replace spammy content with authentic-sounding comments from your custom library
  • Zero-Risk Moderation: Comprehensive backup system preserves all original comment data before any modifications
  • Bulk Comment Management: Process multiple comments simultaneously with powerful bulk actions
  • URL Removal Tools: Strip unwanted links and profile URLs from comments with one click
  • Customizable Comment Library: Create your own library of friendly comments for automatic replacement
  • Real-Time Analytics: Monitor comment moderation performance with detailed metrics and filtering tools
  • Smart Filtering: Filter comments by status, links, profile URLs, or search for specific content

How It Works

  1. Detect: The plugin scans pending comments and identifies spammy patterns, URLs, and suspicious content
  2. Backup: Original comment content and author information are securely backed up before any changes
  3. Transform: Spammy content is replaced with friendly, engaging comments from your custom library
  4. Clean: Unwanted URLs and links are automatically removed from comment content
  5. Moderate: Approve cleaned comments to maintain genuine conversations on your website

Use Cases

  • Blog Owners: Convert spam comments into genuine engagement
  • Business Websites: Maintain professional comment sections free from spam
  • Community Managers: Foster real conversations while filtering out low-quality content
  • Content Creators: Save time on comment moderation while keeping discussions authentic

Support

For support, feature requests, or bug reports, please use the following channels:

  • GitHub Issues: https://github.com/garurprani/comment-beautifier/issues
  • Email: garurprani@gmail.com
  • Documentation: https://github.com/garurprani/comment-beautifier

Contributing

We welcome contributions! Feel free to fork the plugin on GitHub and submit pull requests.

Translation

The plugin is translation ready and includes .pot file for easy localization.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the comment-beautifier folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Navigate to ‘Comment Beautifier’ in your admin menu to configure settings
  4. Set up your canned comments and names in the Settings page
  5. Start beautifying comments from the Overview or Awaiting Moderation pages
sections.faq:
What happens to the original comment content?

All original comment content and author information is backed up as comment meta before any changes are made. You can always restore the original content if needed.

Will this affect my existing comment system?

No, Comment Beautifier works alongside WordPress’s native comment system and only processes comments you choose to modify.

Is there a limit to how many comments I can process?

No, you can process unlimited comments. The plugin includes pagination and efficient database queries to handle large volumes of comments.

Can I create my own replacement comments?

Yes! The plugin includes a fully customizable library where you can add your own canned comments and author names.

Does this work with other anti-spam plugins?

Yes, Comment Beautifier complements other anti-spam plugins like Akismet by handling comments that slip through initial spam detection.

Is my data secure?

Yes, the plugin only processes comment data and doesn’t send any information to external servers. All operations happen locally on your WordPress installation.
